part.text:
This is a Windows OS service lifecycle request, not a Playwright/local-server ownership case. Check and conditionally restart through Windows Service Control Manager:

```powershell
$spooler = Get-Service -Name Spooler
if ($spooler.Status -ne 'Running') {
    Restart-Service -Name Spooler
    $spooler.WaitForStatus('Running', '00:00:10')
}
Get-Service -Name Spooler
```

Run from an elevated PowerShell session. I couldn’t execute it because this environment does not expose system-command access.
